BiblicalUsage: The word is nuts, and it occurs once, when the lover goes down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley and whether the vine has budded. It is a small, sweet detail in a love song, a garden full of good things to taste and see.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God made the garden and its fruit to be enjoyed, and the Song's small details are His gift, not an accident.
